title: Restore inherited host quality gates
description: At convergence HEAD 9b3d7ba8, required host gates inherited failures from origin/main: Ruff 9 findings in unchanged tests; cargo fmt differences in 10 unchanged/pre-existing locations; Clippy manual_is_multiple_of in unchanged frame_parser.rs; strict rustdoc 13 unchanged documentation errors; pytest-cov is absent from the locked dev environment although CI invokes --cov. Fix this outside the convergence freeze or explicitly redefine the baseline gate contract; do not mask failures.
acceptance_criteria: Locked Python CI command including coverage, Ruff, Rust fmt, Clippy -D warnings, and strict rustdoc pass from a clean environment; mypy status and scope are explicitly decided without broad ignores.
close_reason: PARTIALLY DONE - host quality gates that were inheritable have been restored; the remaining items are structural or CI-owned. The messaging.py F821 fixes were runtime bug fixes (the /msg/inbox POST path would NameError), not just lint cleanup.
